title: Start from a template
description: Emily starts with a ready-made management report rather than a blank page.

title: Brand the cover
description: She chooses a cover style that fits the client’s identity.

title: Bring in the financials
description: She adds a balance sheet from the content library; it joins the report and its contents.

title: Shape the KPIs
description: She changes the chart type, adds revenue and resizes the KPI to fit the page.

title: Write with live numbers
description: She writes commentary using variables that resolve to values for the reporting period.

title: Preview the report
description: She checks the complete paginated report as the recipient will see it.

title: Publish and send
description: She publishes and sends the PDF to James; he gets a report he can read before their review.
